name: zvid_texture_pack_ensure_default_image_pack_loaded
description: zVid_TexturePack_EnsureDefaultImagePackLoaded preserves an already-loaded default pack, otherwise allocates a default pack slot, tries image.zbd, falls back to rimage.zbd, and increments the pack count only after a successful load.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x46da40 validates early return when g_zVid_TexturePackCount is positive, reallocating one zVidTexturePackEntry slot, zeroing it, copying image.zbd, trying LoadFromFile, falling back to rimage.zbd through sprintf, and incrementing g_zVid_TexturePackCount only when either load succeeds.

The native smoke verifies the existing-pack early return, the missing-file fallback path that leaves an allocated rimage.zbd slot without incrementing the count, and a successful rimage.zbd fallback load that increments the count and leaves an open pack handle.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs COFF byte comparison passed for _zVid_TexturePack_EnsureDefaultImagePackLoaded at 0x46da40 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after masking 48 relocation bytes; BN size 157, VC object symbol size 160, and 3 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed.
